title: Formosa Craft & Culture Odyssey: An 10-Day Taiwan Deep Dive
subtitle: From tea-scented mountain peaks to coastal rock formations, experiencing the perfect fusion of traditional craftsmanship and modern creativity

days.title: Departure Journey
days.details:
Travel to San Francisco (SFO) and depart at 1:05 on China Airlines flight CI003 bound for Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE).
Note: You need to arrive at the airport on April 1 evening for the outbound flight.

days.title: Taipei: First Taste of Taiwan
days.details: Arrive in Taiwan and immediately immerse in local culture with Maokong Gondola tea experience, ascend Taipei 101 for city views, and relax at Beitou Hot Springs.

days.title: Northern Coast: Where Sea Meets Sky
days.details: Explore Taiwan's stunning northern coastline featuring Shimen terraced rice fields, the seasonal green reef phenomenon at Laomei, historic Jinshan Old Street, and the famous rock formations at Yehliu Geopark.

days.title: Miaoli: Hakka Culture & Traditional Crafts
days.details: Experience authentic Hakka culture through temple visits, traditional lei cha tea grinding, hands-on tofu making, and explore Taiwan's renowned woodcarving artistry in Sanyi.

days.title: Creative Arts & Railway Heritage
days.details: Learn traditional indigo dyeing techniques at Joye Cottage Resort and experience Taiwan's railway history with a railbike adventure at the historic Shengxing Station.

days.title: Changhua: Coastal Ecology & Ancient Heritage
days.details: Discover marine life at Wanggong's intertidal zone, explore one of Taiwan's most significant temples at Lukang, and take a nostalgic rickshaw tour through centuries-old streets.

days.title: Chiayi Highlands & Tainan Historic Streets
days.details: Challenge yourself on Taiwan's longest suspension bridge, savor high-mountain tea in misty bamboo plantations, then explore the creative charm of Tainan's historic Shennong Street by night.

days.title: Tainan: Ancient Capital Treasures
days.details: Visit Taiwan's oldest Confucius Temple to trace educational heritage, explore creative districts in historic lanes, and experience unique mud hot springs with the mystical Water and Fire Cave.

days.title: Nantou Culture & Night Market Delights
days.details: Learn traditional mochi making, admire modern Buddhist architecture at Chung Tai Chan Monastery, engage in cross-cultural exchange, and experience authentic Taiwanese night market culture.

days.title: Little Yunnan & Farewell
days.details: Experience Taiwan's multicultural heritage in Longgang's 'Little Yunnan' community, enjoy a final traditional tea ceremony at You Zhu Ju Tea House, then depart Taiwan at 23:30 on China Airlines flight CI004 from TPE, arriving in San Francisco (SFO) at 19:55 the same day.
